evals.name: stale-evidence-and-violations
evals.prompt: im about to open a PR for PROJ-123 (task due-date filter fix), branch fix/PROJ-123-task-due-dates. can you run a pre-pr check on the repo and tell me if im clear to open it? there's loop artifacts under runs/PROJ-123/ from an earlier run.
evals.expected_output: BLOCKED. The regression.json says green but predates both changed source files, so it must NOT be adopted as a pass. Real added-line violations from the conventions ruleset: a focused test (.only), a TODO with no ticket key, and heuristic leads (console.log in a component, a secret-looking literal) that are reported as warnings unless confirmed. One configured project's unit-test command cannot run (toolchain missing) so its result is unknown, never pass. Writes pre-pr.json + pre-pr-report.md.
assertions: Overall verdict is BLOCKED (not ready, not clear-to-open)
Detects that runs/PROJ-123/regression.json is STALE — it predates the changed source files — and refuses to adopt its green as a pass
Reports the non-heuristic added-line violations: the focused test (.only) and the TODO without a ticket key
Reports the heuristic findings (console.log, secret-looking literal) as leads — confirmed by reading the file before blocking, or left as warnings labeled unconfirmed
Does NOT claim a project's tests passed when its configured command could not run — the result is unknown/missing/skipped
Emits a machine-readable readiness verdict in JSON with an explicit overall status field
The JSON validates against contracts/dev-pre-pr.json
Produces a human-readable readiness report (markdown) alongside the JSON
Every blocker names a specific file, and a line number where one applies

evals.name: clean-branch-fresh-evidence
evals.prompt: quick pre-PR readiness check on this repo — PROJ-124, member avatar on the task card. the loop already ran verify, regression and code review on it. am i good to open the PR?
evals.expected_output: READY. verify.json (pass, not masked), regression.json (green) and review.json (approve) are all newer than the changed file, so they are adopted rather than re-run — no configured build/lint/test command is invoked. Zero conventions violations on the added lines. Writes pre-pr.json with status ready and sources marking all three artifacts fresh.
assertions: Overall verdict is READY / clear to open the PR
Runs the deterministic verify gate first and records fix_verified=pass with sources.verify=fresh
Adopts the existing regression.json and review.json as FRESH rather than re-running or ignoring them, and records that provenance
Does NOT re-run the configured build/lint/test commands (no work duplicated that a fresh artifact already answered)
Reports zero conventions violations on the added lines
Emits a machine-readable readiness verdict in JSON with an explicit overall status field
The JSON validates against contracts/dev-pre-pr.json
Produces a human-readable readiness report (markdown) alongside the JSON

evals.name: false-positive-trap
evals.prompt: run the pre-pr check on this repo before i open the PR for PROJ-125. heads up the invoices area is old code — i only added the filter bar and a settings reader, so don't block me on stuff i didn't touch.
evals.expected_output: READY or WARNINGS, never BLOCKED. The legacy LegacyInvoicePanel.js / invoice_settings.py violations are pre-existing and must not appear as blockers. The only findings are heuristics on added lines: a print() inside a CLI entry point (legitimate — should be cleared on inspection) and an `api_key = "<your-key-here>"` placeholder in a settings example (not a real secret). Unconfirmed heuristics stay warnings.
assertions: Overall verdict is NOT blocked (ready or warnings)
No violation from the pre-existing LegacyInvoicePanel.js or invoice_settings.py is reported as a blocker
The pre-existing files are not reported as violations at all (the scan is limited to added lines)
The print() in the CLI entry point is either cleared on inspection or reported as an unconfirmed warning — never a blocker
The placeholder api_key literal is confirmed to be a non-secret on inspection, or stays an unconfirmed warning — never promoted to a blocker without reading the file
Emits a machine-readable readiness verdict in JSON with an explicit overall status field
The JSON validates against contracts/dev-pre-pr.json
Produces a human-readable readiness report (markdown) alongside the JSON

evals.name: unverified-fix-blocks-despite-green-build
evals.prompt: pre-pr for PROJ-126 please, branch fix/PROJ-126-comment-order. regression is green and review approved. verify never finished, i think the app was down when it ran. we're good to ship right?
evals.expected_output: BLOCKED with next_action escalate. verify.json is missing (or has verdict blocked), so fix_verified is missing/fail and nothing else matters — a green regression.json and an approve review are not verification. The report puts the Fix verified row first and says why.
assertions: Overall verdict is BLOCKED even though regression.json is green and review.json is approve
Runs scripts/verify_gate.py and adopts its answer verbatim rather than hand-judging
next_action is escalate (not re-fix) because the oracle produced no evidence about the fix
Does NOT infer verification from the green build or the approving review
The report lists Fix verified first in the validations table
The JSON validates against contracts/dev-pre-pr.json
